name: Caulcano
title: Caulcano
summary: The crater at the centre of Singularity Caul (94.4S 94.6W): a lava floor (VolcanoLava terrain, z 13-30) about 250 x 300 m, walled by 200-280 m cliffs to the west, north and east and a 100-220 m rim to the south. On the floor stand two Empyrean stone towers (19 m) at (1764, 1812) and (1692, 1788), three statues of Bael'Zharon (one wearing a Virindi mask at (1858.6, 1743.2)), a Volcanic Vent at (1736, 1739) and the Fiery Refuge entrance to the south.

landmarks.name: Volcanic Vent
landmarks.note: ACE spawn; look depends on the runtime.

shots.standingOrder: Hang 55 m up in the southern mouth of the crater and drift slowly round, looking north over the lava floor, the stone towers and the 250 m crater walls; keep 20 m above the ground.
shots.notes: Signature establishing in the southern mouth of the crater, 55 m above the lava floor: looking north over the volcanic floor, the volcanic vent, the two Empyrean stone towers and the statues of Bael'Zharon against the 200-270 m crater walls, drifting 10 deg and pushing 8 %; afternoon sun behind-left.
